text: Picture this: you’re sitting on a cluttered coffee table, your wallet feels heavier than a sack of lead, yet you swear you’re “earning enough” because your salary looks nice on paper.
You says it, you hear it: “It’s not my salary.” That’s the story we’re about to juggle—why you’re always broke, and why the paycheck alone won’t light up the bank account.
Ever notice how the same Monday, you shuffle out the door, your paycheck lands, and the money just…
